consistency_gates_R48_vs_R96.rule: relative difference <= 0.20 at T, 2T and 3T and <= 0.50 at 4T

decision_rule.all_five_pass: GO: propose local conservative flux-mechanism validation
decision_rule.G1_G2_G3_pass_only: modes consistent, transport not; the limitation is not horizontal resolution, and the next test is a dt-matched or vertically refined leg, not R192
decision_rule.G1_G2_G3_not_all_pass: horizontal resolution is still the limiter at 4T; report the limitation and do not propose mechanism validation

limitation_attribution.horizontal_resolution: G1-G3 fail and the short-wave energy keeps falling with h
limitation_attribution.temporal_integration: G1-G3 pass while G5 fails, given the WP6 finding of a 68 percent mid-window change at 1 mm under dt halving
limitation_attribution.vertical_resolution: nz=200 is common to all three legs and is never tested here; it can only be named as untested
limitation_attribution.domain_width: the box admits only Neumann modes m=1,2,...; the LSA global critical mode nx=5 cannot appear at any resolution
